thread:
Sam: kicking off staggered rollout v2.14.0 -> eu1 (30% subset) at 2026-03-21T09:20Z. monitoring synth probes and kv-prefill metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0 service=inference-proxy region=eu1 stage=canary percent=30 status=IN_PROGRESS

Maria: synth-embed probe failing in eu1 within first 2 mins, p95 elevated, errors spiking. grabbing traces. :eyes:

deploy-bot: smoke-check synth-embed-eu1 result=FAIL metrics={p50:0.41s, p95:3.05s, error_rate:5.1%} threshold_p95=0.8s

Jordan: what shape are the errors? 5xx or client timeouts?

Maria: mostly 503 returned from inference-proxy upstream. examples: ```
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] inference-proxy eu1 - upstream_status=503 upstream_service=model-serving exec=88ms - "POST /v1/embeddings"
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] kv-cache miss prefix="user:prefill"
```

Derek: exec=88ms with 503 suggests the model container closed connection after internal reject. any memory/gpu errors in model-serving logs?

Sam: build v2.14.0 included a routing tweak for embed model variants and a tokenizer patch. neither should cause 503s but routing could select a variant with higher memory requirements.

Maria: model-serving shows OOM kills then rapid restarts on ~3/10 canary pods. correlated with the subset assigned by the canary balancer.

Ryan: I'm oncall, will flip fallback to previous stable for embed route in eu1 while you triage. prefer region-scoped pin rather than global rollback.

Sam: agree, hold the rollout. pin eu1 embed to v2.13.9 until we understand root cause.

Derek: plan: hold global rollout, apply region pin to 100% v2.13.9 for embed route in eu1, continue triage and prepare rollback or quick hotfix depending on findings. create incident ticket.

Maria: sounds good. hotfix path: revert the routing change only (v2.14.1) and smoke-test in staging. pin is least-disruptive.

deploy-bot: ACTION: hold rollout for v2.14.0 (eu1). command suggestion: ```
# pin eu1 embed route to previous stable
redwoodctl route update --service inference-proxy --region eu1 --route embed --pin-version v2.13.9 --reason "postdeploy synth failures"
```

Sam: executing the pin command now. will confirm once applied.

Sam: applied. deploy-bot: please confirm traffic split and probe status.

deploy-bot: route update applied service=inference-proxy region=eu1 route=embed pinned_version=v2.13.9 status=OK

Maria: re-running synth-embed probe from CI — p95 dropping to 0.48s, error_rate ~0.6%. good recovery. :thumbsup:

Ryan: opening INC-4521, linking runbook and logs. assigning to Jordan for triage and Derek for rollback/hotfix plan. tagging SupportOps and Product.

Jordan: starting triage. checking autoscaler metrics and kernel selection changes in the build. also reproducing in minikube with same image to see if pod-level OOM triggered by model variant.

Derek: adding action item for postmortem checklist: improve canary subset determinism across AZs — affected subset was 3/10 and seemed infrastructure-skewed.

Sam: next steps: 1) keep eu1 embed pinned until fix or hotfix, 2) replicate failing pod image locally, 3) if root cause is routing/model selection, cut hotfix v2.14.1 with the routing revert, smoke in staging, then re-rollout, 4) update release notes with incident summary & mitigation and link INC-4521.

Maria: updating the internal release notes draft now with incident blurb and mitigation details.

Ryan: notifying Product and Support: EU embed traffic pinned to previous version; customers may see transient errors if they hit impacted pods before the pin. @SupportOps acknowledge.

SupportOps: acknowledged. we'll watch support queues and escalate if customers report embed errors.

Sam: thanks all. holding rollout and moving discussion to the triage channel. will escalate if we observe cross-region impact. :white_check_mark:
